drhp.business: UDTL designs, manufactures and supports downhole tools, well service equipment, gas lift systems, wireline winch units, and large-outside-diameter casing pipes and connectors for oil and gas operators. Products are engineered to customer specification and sold both directly to domestic operators and drilling contractors and, internationally, through partners, dedicated representatives and appointed agents. The Company also earns from installation, inspection, repair and maintenance services around its installed base.
